commitMessage: feat(storage): implement LocalStorage service with CRUD operations and error handling
prBody: Implemented `src/lib/storage.ts` with `getVideos`, `addVideo`, `deleteVideo`, `updateVideo`, and `saveToLocalStorage`. Updated `Video` type to include `notes`. Added error handling for storage quotas and JSON parsing. Verified with `src/lib/storage.test.ts`.
notes: Modified Video type to support embedded notes for easier local storage management.
